1 · Intro

When to use it.

Leave processing at Vanderbilt differs for monthly and biweekly employees, mainly because their time off lives in different systems and their pay closes on different schedules.

Exempt (monthly) time off is managed in Oracle. Non-exempt (biweekly) time off is managed in UKG.

Use this whenYou are processing a leave and need to know where the time goes and what deadline applies.

Watch-outs

  • Do not enter a non-exempt employee's time off in Oracle Add Absence or an exempt employee's in UKG. It goes to the wrong system and pay will be wrong.
  • Open item: how FMLA and other protected leaves are tracked for biweekly employees (UKG pay codes, Oracle absence records, or both) is not yet documented.

HCM Academy job aid · Leave Management

Differences in processing leaves for monthly vs. biweekly employees

Use when: You are processing a leave and need to know where the time goes and what deadline applies. · System: Process

  1. Check the employee's pay frequency and exempt status first.
  2. Monthly (exempt): record time off in Oracle with Add Absence.
  3. Monthly: get it entered and approved before the exempt payroll cutoff.
  4. Biweekly (non-exempt): time off goes on the UKG time card.
    • PTO is in 4-hour increments
    • In an open pay period, Save, don't Submit
  5. Biweekly: pay depends on approved time cards, so check them weekly.
  6. For both: update the leave status in Oracle when a leave starts and ends.
